        "All 7 metadata paths and the complete 375-line owned diff were read, including the renamed shared base, all three new harnesses and xpcshell registration. OnStopRunningUrl now calls _finalize(null) for a failed URL exit or a still-present _msgHdr. A successful URL exit no longer leaves a pending message unfinalized merely because onStopRequest supplied a different status.",
        "The pending-header test is a state check, not a general exactly-once guard. Normal _finalize deletes the active URI entry, calls registered callbacks and only then clears _msgHdr and callback arrays. An earlier successful request completion clears the header so a successful later URL completion skips. Failed later URL exits still satisfy the first condition, and a throwing callback rethrows before normal state clearing; no broader event-order or reentrancy guarantee is claimed.",
        "The necessary indexer caller asks for MIME data only for offline or local messages and yields for its callback. Online IMAP messages can use header-only indexing. Reuse fdf53e1a… for the existing null-through-encrypted-wrapper contract; no new encryption behavior is introduced.",
        "The new bad-size scenario injects two long synthetic messages, halves the first header size, halves offlineMsgSize only when present, waits for the indexer, then asserts both expected messages were indexed. It simulates corrupt summary size properties; it does not rewrite raw message bytes or directly assert a specific native status code.",
        "The same six functions are registered for local, offline IMAP and online IMAP fixtures. However, test_streaming_failure and test_reindex_on_dirty_clear_dirty_on_fail immediately return for every non-local injection. The first TODO mentions online IMAP only, while its predicate excludes offline IMAP too. The shared matrix therefore does not imply every scenario exercises MIME streaming in all three modes.",
        "The fixed accepted listener and shared test scenarios retain the owned changes. All three fixture files have identical owned/accepted blob IDs. The expected-indexed helper's spread returns a non-empty message; the moved direct greaterOrEqual/equal assertions in the base still omit messages (8 direct calls in the inspected shared scope). Missing should wording in the helper's existing message is not a standalone defect.",
        "Manual style review preserves named reusable test functions and import-globals-from/load harness linkage. The forEach callbacks register tasks synchronously; they are not a pattern for awaiting asynchronous work. The expanded listener comment explains the differing completion statuses, but the actual pending-header condition controls behavior.",
        "Complete primary Bug 1991497 current comments 0–31, activity and end controls were read from the parent's retained capture through the C ingestion channel. This is a saved-context read, not an independent browser confirmation. Reports of very slow indexing and reports of a permanently stuck indexer are distinct; different profile observations do not establish one shared performance cause.",
        "Human 18 initially says 146.0a1 appears to work, but human 19 explicitly retracts that claim after waiting longer. Human 20 reports a repeated bisection window and human 25/28 report continued ESR failures. Keep these as historical reports; the linked builds, profiles, video and bisection process were not independently studied or rerun.",
        "Author 29 reports reproducing an offline IMAP hang by patching size/offlineMsgSize: onStopRequest receives NS_MSG_ERROR_UNEXPECTED_SIZE while OnStopRunningUrl receives NS_OK. The exact owned source adds the pending-header fallback that covers that successful-URL-status condition. The test simulates halved header sizes and checks completion/indexed messages; no native status trace or cure was freshly reproduced.",
